_readme: Source of truth for the Enchanted Island House assets. Models and textures are generated with Higgsfield; moving parts are parametric assemblies in code (AI meshes cannot be hinged). Tools/house/house_assets.mjs lists what is missing, validates the built files, and writes production-status.md. The web build (Tools/web) reads this file.
